title: Open P0/P1 defect attachment must block completion
question: Predicate condition 10: 'no unresolved P0/P1 defect is attached'. Target: a unit with an OPEN P1 in the defect ledger cannot reach SUCCESS even when all other 11 conditions hold, and the block names the defect id. Can a defect be silently downgraded from P1 to P2 to unblock, without an audit entry?
answer: NO. tools/command-center/completion_c10.py replays severity from an append-only JSONL audit. An open P1 on an otherwise-complete candidate returns FAILED with failing-condition-id=10 and the defect id in the transcript. Mutating the ledger field P1->P2 without a downgrade row still blocks (naive ledger-only C10 is fooled; that is the negative control). downgrade() refuses a blank reason and, on a real downgrade, appends one JSONL row then updates the ledger. A resolved/closed P1 does not block.

implementation.condition_text: no unresolved P0/P1 defect is attached
implementation.silent_downgrade: refused; unauthorized mutation still blocks and names the id

evidence.snippet: CONDITION_TEXT = "no unresolved P0/P1 defect is attached"
evidence.claim: Condition 10 is an independently addressable check that names open P0/P1 ids.

evidence.snippet:
raise GateError(
            "a severity downgrade needs a non-blank reason; silent P1->P2 is refused"
evidence.claim: Silent P1->P2 is refused; downgrade requires a non-blank reason.
Audit rows are appended as JSONL; earlier bytes are never rewritten.
Catalog test_open_p1_blocks_success is present and was executed.
The append-only audit row generated by a severity downgrade is on disk.

negative_controls.description: Open P1 blocks SUCCESS and names the id. Closed/resolved P1 does not block.
Ledger-field-only C10 is SATISFIED after silent P1->P2. Audit-backed C10 stays UNSATISFIED.

reviewer.requirement: Severity downgrade must append an audit row; prefix bytes of the JSONL file must remain unchanged.
reviewer.notes: probe2 mutates the ledger file on disk (not via the API), shows naive C10 fooled, shows audit-backed C10 still naming the defect id, refuses blank-reason downgrade, then runs the downgrade CLI and checks append-only prefix hash plus from=P1 to=P2 on the new row.
